# Exploratory N Calculations Corn.

```{r}
df_corn_calculations <- read_excel("../data/Corn_N_calculations.xlsx", sheet = "R6 Combined_real")
df_corn_calculations



```


```{r}
df_corn_calc_pivot <- df_corn_calculations %>%
  pivot_longer( cols = 9:13,
                names_to = "parameters",
                values_to = "values")

df_corn_calc_pivot
```




```{r}
ggplot(data = df_corn_calc_pivot,
         aes(x = values)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_grid(~parameters, scales = "free")
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_corn_calc_pivot,
       aes(x = values)) +
  geom_density(
    fill = "#2C7FB8",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameters,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Corn Nitrogen-Related Parameters",
    x = "Parameter value",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_corn_calc_pivot,
       aes(sample = values)) +
  stat_qq(
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_qq_line(
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameters,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Q-Q Plots of Corn Nitrogen Parameters",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

df_corr <- df_corn_calculations %>%
  select(
    NNI_Leaf	,
    NNI_Stalk,
   NNI_Ear,
    `R1 NNI`,
   `R6_NNI_Combined`
  ) %>%
  cor(
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )

df_corr %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable_1") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Variable_1,
    names_to = "Variable_2",
    values_to = "Correlation"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Variable_1,
    y = Variable_2,
    fill = Correlation
  )) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Among Corn Nitrogen Parameters",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_corn_calculations,
       aes(
         x = factor(DAP),
         y = NNI_Leaf, color =`Study/Field`
       )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#2C7FB8",
    alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variation in Corn NNI Across Sampling Dates",
    x = "Days After Planting",
    y = "Nitrogen Nutrition Index"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
```
